title: High-fidelity Three-Dimensional Flow Field Reconstruction Driven by Turbulent Fluid Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.18045v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-fidelity three-dimensional turbulent flow fields are essential for scientific and engineering analyses, yet obtaining them through direct numerical simulation or high-resolution measurements remains expensive. Super-resolution reconstruction from coarse-grained data therefore offers a promising alternative, but remains fundamentally challenging because fine-scale structures are intrinsically three-dimensional and dynamically coupled across scales. Existing data-driven approaches still struggle to recover multiscale volumetric structures and their coherent temporal evolution. To address these limitations, we propose a turbulence-aware framework for time-resolved three-dimensional flow reconstruction. The framework couples a multiscale neural operator, designed to recover volumetric structures, with a state space model to promote temporal consistency in the reconstructed dynamics. translated_title: 基于湍流流体动力学驱动的高保真三维流场重构
translated_abstract: 高保真三维湍流流场对于科学和工程分析至关重要，然而通过直接数值模拟或高分辨率测量获取这些流场的成本仍然十分高昂。因此，从粗粒化数据进行超分辨率重构提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但这在根本上仍具挑战性，因为细尺度结构本质上是三维的，并且跨尺度动态耦合。现有的数据驱动方法仍难以恢复多尺度体积结构及其相干的时间演化。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种面向时间分辨三维流场重构的湍流感知框架。该框架将一个旨在恢复体积结构的多尺度神经算子与一个状态空间模型相耦合，以促进重构动力学的时间一致性。此外，还引入了Navier-Stokes（纳维-斯托克斯）残差（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种湍流感知的三维流场重构框架，通过耦合多尺度神经算子与状态空间模型，并结合Navier-Stokes残差约束，实现了从粗粒化数据出发的高保真、时间一致的三维湍流流场超分辨率重构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a turbulence-aware framework that couples a multiscale neural operator with a state space model, incorporating Navier-Stokes residuals, to achieve high-fidelity and temporally consistent super-resolution reconstruction of three-dimensional turbulent flow fields from coarse-grained data.
